item.title: Jamb v1.0.0
item.description:
• Initial release: press ⌃⌥J and every text input visible on screen — across all apps and windows — gets a label chip and a highlight; type the label and the caret jumps there, ready to type.
  • Cross-app jumps activate the target app and raise its window; fields in background apps work the same as the active one.
  • Works with native apps, Electron apps (their accessibility tree is woken automatically), and web pages — Safari out of the box, Chromium browsers after enabling web accessibility (Jamb shows a one-time walkthrough per browser).
  • Label keys match by keyboard position, so non-Latin input sources (e.g. Korean) and alternative Latin layouts (Dvorak) both work.
  • First-run onboarding gates on the Accessibility permission; a customizable global shortcut lives in Settings, and Sparkle keeps the app up to date.

item.title: Jamb v1.1.0
item.description:
1.1.0

Added

  • Jamb is available in Korean. The menu, Settings, welcome window, and browser setup guide follow the macOS language.

Changed

  • Settings uses the system's grouped style, with section headers and rounded boxes like Xcode's settings.

Fixed

  • A shortcut recorded while a Korean input source was on showed a Korean letter instead of the key.
  • A shortcut using F1 through F20 showed a blank key.
  • Closing Settings or switching apps while recording the shortcut left it off until Settings was opened again.

1.0.6

Fixed

  • The Settings window could no longer be dragged after a switch in it was flipped.

1.0.5

Fixed

  • The app icon's background looked flat in the Dock and Finder. It now shows its gradient.

1.1.0

추가

  • 한국어를 지원합니다. macOS 언어가 한국어이면 메뉴, 설정, 환영 화면, 브라우저 설정 안내가 한국어로 표시됩니다.

변경

  • 설정 창을 Xcode 설정처럼 섹션 제목과 둥근 상자로 나뉜 시스템 스타일로 바꿨습니다.

수정

  • 한글 입력 상태에서 녹화한 단축키가 키 대신 한글 자모로 표시되던 문제를 수정했습니다.
  • F1부터 F20까지의 키를 쓴 단축키가 빈칸으로 표시되던 문제를 수정했습니다.
  • 단축키를 녹화하는 도중 설정 창을 닫거나 다른 앱으로 전환하면 설정을 다시 열 때까지 단축키가 동작하지 않던 문제를 수정했습니다.

1.0.6

수정

  • 설정 창의 스위치를 켜거나 끈 뒤 창을 끌어 옮길 수 없던 문제를 수정했습니다.

1.0.5
